topic: How to Clean a Bathtub Without Damaging the Finish
notes: Make finish/material identification the first step. Acrylic and other finished tubs can be damaged by abrasives or incompatible solvents, so use a soft cloth or sponge and manufacturer-approved cleaner guidance. For unfamiliar surfaces, recommend a small inconspicuous test and defer to the tub manufacturer. Do not present one chemical recipe as universal for all tub finishes.
